a.lede: David Robinson joins other insiders in urging industry to take more care over rapidly developing technology A safety leader at OpenAI has quit the company, warning that its culture was broken and that AI firms were not “being nearly careful enough” about developing the technology. David Robinson, who led the writing of safety reports that accompanied the ChatGPT developer’s product
a.title: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company’s culture is ‘broken’

b.lede: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.
b.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
